about: Hand-written rewrites for Model SDK types and properties that Mendix removed (most removals carry no message in the SDK) or that are easy to misuse. Key: <namespace>.<Type> or <namespace>.<DeclaringType>.<property>. removedIn must equal the SDK runtime metadata (selftest checks it, and that every name in 'use' exists). use: what to write instead; note: how. kind 'name': the property takes a name (text), not an element. Writable projects are Mendix 10.18+, so these mostly correct stale SDK knowledge in scripts and plans.

pages.GridDatabaseSource.note: same entityRef (domainmodels.DirectEntityRef) and sortBar; xPathConstraint "" means all objects, or e.g. "[Status = 'Open']"

pages.ListViewDatabaseSource.note: same entityRef and sortBar; xPathConstraint "" means all objects

pages.DatabaseSourceBase.note: the XPath sources do the same with xPathConstraint "" (all objects)

pages.DatabaseConstraint.note: one XPath text on the XPath source, e.g. "[Status = 'Open' and Amount > 0]"

pages.DataView.editable.note: dv.editability = sdk.pages.EditableEnum.Never (read-only), Always, or Conditional (with conditionalEditabilitySettings)

pages.DataViewSource.pageParameter.note: a data view on a page parameter: const v = sdk.pages.PageVariable.createInEntityPathSourceUnderSourceVariable(src); v.pageParameter = param

pages.AttributeWidgetWithPlaceholder.pla.note: a pages.ClientTemplate: set the text in placeholderTemplate.template (texts.Text)

pages.DesignPropertyValue.type.note: a typed value: pages.ToggleDesignPropertyValue (on), pages.OptionDesignPropertyValue (option = "..."), pages.CustomDesignPropertyValue (value = "..."), pages.CompoundDesignPropertyValue

pages.DesignPropertyValue.booleanValue.note: pages.ToggleDesignPropertyValue (present = on; leave the design property out for off)

pages.PageSettings.location.note: no replacement: the target page's layout decides (a popup layout opens as a popup)

pages.PageSettings.formTitle.note: a microflows.TextTemplate, or null to keep the page's own title

documenttemplates.DataGridColumn.note: document templates (PDF/Word export) only; a column of a data grid on a page is pages.GridColumn

pages.ListenTargetSource.note: data source of a data view that shows the selected row of another widget on the same page: set listenTarget to that widget's name; inputs inside leave sourceVariable null

pages.ListenTargetSource.listenTarget.note: the NAME (text) of a data grid / list view / gallery on the same page, e.g. "dataGrid1"; not an entity or widget object

pages.AttributeWidget.sourceVariable.note: leave null for inputs inside a data view (also a listening one): the input uses the data view's object (Studio Pro writes SourceVariable: null)

pages.AssociationWidget.sourceVariable.note: leave null for inputs inside a data view (also a listening one): the input uses the data view's object (Studio Pro writes SourceVariable: null)

microflows.SequenceFlow.caseValue.note: a list: sdk.microflows.EnumerationCase.createInSequenceFlowUnderCaseValues(flow).value = "true" (or an enumeration value name); NoCase for the default

microflows.Flow.originBezierVector.note: leave the default line (Studio Pro routes it); microflows.BezierCurve or microflows.OrthogonalPath

microflows.Flow.destinationBezierVector.note: leave the default line (Studio Pro routes it); microflows.BezierCurve or microflows.OrthogonalPath

microflows.Flow.lineType.note: microflows.BezierCurve or microflows.OrthogonalPath; usually leave the default

microflows.EmailMessage.subject.note: a microflows.StringTemplate: text with {1} placeholders plus arguments
